Thus the sequence has period \(4\):
\[
\frac35,\frac15,\frac25,\frac45
\]

\[
\frac35+\frac15+\frac25+\frac45=2.
\]
Since \(2016=4\cdot 504\),
\[
S_{2016}=504\cdot 2=1008.
\]
